title: Avocado, Egg & Chili Toast
description: A ten-minute breakfast of toasted sourdough, lemon-smashed avocado, a jammy egg and a slick of chilli crisp.

ingredients.name: thick sourdough slice
ingredients.note: cut from the middle of the loaf

ingredients.name: sea salt flakes and black pepper

steps.text: Bring a small pan of water to a gentle simmer and lower in the egg; cook for 6–7 minutes for a jammy yolk.
Meanwhile, toast the sourdough until deep golden on both sides.
Scoop the avocado into a bowl and roughly smash with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt — keep it chunky.
Drain the egg, cool briefly under cold running water, then peel and halve.
Spread the avocado on the toast, top with the egg halves, and drizzle with the chilli crisp and olive oil.
Finish with the coriander, salt flakes and a good grind of black pepper.

notesMarkdown:
## Cooking the egg

For a **runny** yolk, drop the egg into barely simmering water for 5 minutes;
for a fully set yolk, go to 8. A jammy 6–7 minutes is the sweet spot for toast.

## Substitutions

- **Vegan:** use soft silken tofu instead of the egg and leave out the coriander.
- Swap chilli crisp for smoked chilli flakes and a squeeze of lime.

## Storage

This one is strictly *eat immediately* — the avocado browns fast.
